title: LLM architecture record
description: One record per model. Numbers come from a fetched source; a number not published is null and has an entry in `unknowns`. Every non-null leaf field is covered by `field_sources` (exact path, or a prefix ending in `.*`). Component kinds use the ids in glossary.json. Version 1.1.0 adds optional fields only (see SCHEMA-CHANGES.md): layer_kinds, attention.attention_free, attention.window_kind, attention.kv_shared_layers, attention.sparse.index_shared_layers, ffn.ffn_free, moe.shared_expert_hidden_dim, moe.layer_step, params.effective, params.active_prefill, params.active_decode, and the ref kind config_mirror.

id.description: kebab-case, stable; used in URLs and parent links

family.description: lineage name, e.g. llama, gemma, deepseek, qwen, kimi, inkling

parent_id.description: id of the record this model was derived from or most closely extends

closed.description: true when no weights are public; the record then rests on a paper or official post

repo.description: Hugging Face repo id of the official weights

active.description: per token; equals total for a dense model

text_only.description: decoder stack plus embeddings, when the total includes towers

effective.description: the lab's 'effective' size when it leaves out parts such as per-layer embedding tables

active_prefill.description: active per token while reading the prompt, when it differs from decode

active_decode.description: active per token while generating, when it differs from prefill

layers.description: decoder blocks in the main stack; excludes MTP and tower layers

vocab_size.description: rows of the embedding matrix as in config (often padded)

trained.description: length the paper says it was trained or extended to, when it differs

stated_vocab.description: vocabulary the paper states, if different from vocab_size

kind.description: glossary id of the main token mixer: mha, mqa, gqa, mla, hybrid; for an attention-free model, the recurrent mixer (ssm_mamba, rwkv, mlstm) with attention_free true

attention_free.description: true when no layer uses softmax attention; kind then names the recurrent mixer

mixers.description: for hybrids: each token-mixer kind and how many layers use it

window.description: window size in tokens for local layers (see window_kind); null if none

window_kind.description: sliding: each token sees the last `window` tokens; chunked: tokens see only their own block of `window` tokens

kv_shared_layers.description: layers that reuse another layer's keys and values instead of computing their own; layer_kinds.*.kv_source says which

local_global.description: ratio as 'L:G', e.g. '5:1'; null if all layers alike

scheme.description: glossary id: learned_absolute, rope, alibi, relative_bias, nope, none, mixed

scaling.description: glossary id: yarn, linear_interpolation, llama3_rope_scaling, log_length_scaling

index_shared_layers.description: layers that run no indexer and reuse another layer's top-k choice

other.description: glossary ids of extras: attention_sink, gated_attention, softcap_attn, query_pre_attn_scalar

ffn_free.description: true when blocks have no feed-forward sublayer (Mamba)

activation.description: glossary id: relu, gelu, gelu_tanh, swiglu, geglu, situ_glu

hidden_dim.description: dense FFN width; for an all-MoE model, null

config_activation.description: raw string from config, e.g. silu, gelu_new

latent_dim.description: LatentMoE: width tokens are projected to before routed experts

dense_layers.description: which layers keep a dense FFN, e.g. 'first 3'

shared_expert_hidden_dim.description: width of one shared expert, set only when it differs from expert_hidden_dim

layer_step.description: MoE every n-th layer after the dense prefix (2 = dense and MoE alternate); omitted when every layer is MoE

stack.description: how layer types repeat down the stack, so a drawing can show the pattern

block_order.description: ordered sublayers of one decoder block, top of the residual stream first

only_on.description: stack type name(s) this step applies to, joined by ', ' when several (e.g. 'chunked_moe, global_nope_moe'); for a step tied to single layers, a layer list starting with a digit

basis.description: what fixes the order; tensor_names means parts are certain, order inferred

refs.description: source list, keyed by short id; kind config_mirror is a gated config read through a public copy: url is the copy, note names the original

field_sources.description: field path (dot form; prefix.* covers a subtree) -> ref ids

figure_links.description: others' diagrams of this model; linked, never copied

unknowns.description: field path -> why it is null or uncertain

notes.description: conflicts between sources, and which one the record follows

teaches.description: glossary ids this model is the course's example of

layer_kinds.description: settings per layer kind, keyed by the type names used in stack; validate.py requires it when the stack has two or more types. Top-level attention fields keep describing the main kind.

mixer.description: glossary id of the token mixer, or 'none' (a feed-forward-only layer)

ffn.description: glossary id: mlp, glu, moe, latent_moe; or 'none' (a mixer-only layer)

heads.description: query heads (for linear mixers: query/key heads)

head_dim.description: query/key head size; heads x head_dim need not equal d_model

v_head_dim.description: value head size, when given apart from head_dim

compress_ratio.description: past tokens pooled into one cached entry (CSA, HCA)

position.description: glossary id of the position scheme on this kind, or 'none'

kv_source.description: which layers reuse which layer's keys and values

type.description: layer type label: global, local, kda, dsa, mamba, conv, dense_ffn, moe ...
